description: Candidate (redact-secret 6d61c27, beta.9 candidate) re-measurement of the adapter overhead harnesses: five independent processes per language, alternating js/py, sequential, on the same Apple M4 workstation as the beta.8 baseline. Measurements only; scratch evidence, not committed.

provenance.harnessNote: Detached git worktree of the harness commit; tree clean during every process.

core.javascript: @redact-secret/core tarball packed from redact-secret d4bab4e (JS and wasm identical to 6d61c27) + @redact-secret/node-darwin-arm64 addon rebuilt with napi --release from 6d61c27; package version string still reads 0.1.0-beta.8
core.python: redact_secret wheel built with maturin --release --locked from 6d61c27; version string still reads 0.1.0b8

provenance.command: node scripts/measure-overhead.mjs --out js-N.json; python scripts/measure-overhead.py --out py-N.json (defaults: 15 repetitions x 400 events, 200 warm-up events per mode), alternating, N=1..5

method.order: modes interleaved within each repetition, rotated by one position per repetition

limitations: Host-dependent: these numbers describe this machine and runtime only.
Per-event times are batch means over eventsPerRepetition events; the distribution is across repetitions, not across single events.
derived values are differences of medians, not medians of differences, and can be negative within noise.
The OpenTelemetry exporter is a no-op, so export cost is excluded; pino writes to a no-op destination, so I/O cost is excluded.
This output carries no threshold and no verdict.
